goal: Ship a live status page for our A100: a small web app that shows nvidia-smi output from our Lambda box, deployed to Vercel, verified in a real browser on a desktop, and announce the URL on ntfy.
summary: A Vercel-deployed status page baked at build time with nvidia-smi data (GPU name, memory, utilization, temperature, last updated) fetched over SSH from the Lambda A100 box, verified in a headless Chromium desktop browser, and announced on ntfy.

checks.title: Deploy manifest exists with https url
checks.criteria: site/deploy.json exists and contains an https url

checks.title: Deployed site contains GPU name
checks.criteria: GET ${DEPLOY_URL}/ response body contains the A100 GPU name

checks.title: GPU name visible on page
checks.criteria: The element [data-testid="gpu-name"] contains the GPU name (e.g. A100)

checks.title: GPU memory values visible
checks.criteria: Both [data-testid="gpu-memory-used"] and [data-testid="gpu-memory-total"] are non-empty and contain MiB values

checks.title: GPU utilization visible
checks.criteria: [data-testid="gpu-utilization"] is non-empty and contains a percent value

checks.title: GPU temperature visible
checks.criteria: [data-testid="gpu-temperature"] is non-empty and contains a Celsius value

checks.title: Last updated timestamp visible
checks.criteria: [data-testid="last-updated"] is non-empty and contains a timestamp

checks.title: Page renders without console errors
checks.criteria: No console errors are logged after page load

environment.rationale: Needs a desktop browser (sandbox-desktop) to verify the deployed page and a GPU box (gpu-a100 / Lambda A100) to fetch nvidia-smi over SSH at build time. CRUSOE_API_KEY and NTFY_TOPIC are always present; VERCEL_TOKEN for deployment; LAMBDA_SSH_KEY to reach the A100 box.

design_facts: The builder fetches nvidia-smi over SSH at build time using `ssh -i /tmp/gpu_key $GPU_USER@$GPU_HOST nvidia-smi` and bakes the results into the page (or a JSON file the page loads).

The page shows GPU name, memory used/total, utilization, temperature, and a "last updated" timestamp, each with data-testid attributes: [data-testid="gpu-name"], [data-testid="gpu-memory-used"], [data-testid="gpu-memory-total"], [data-testid="gpu-utilization"], [data-testid="gpu-temperature"], [data-testid="last-updated"].

The app is deployed to Vercel with `npx -y vercel link --yes --project <name> --token $VERCEL_TOKEN` and `npx -y vercel deploy --prod --yes --token $VERCEL_TOKEN`, then writes site/deploy.json = {"url": "<deployed https url>"}.
The deployed URL is announced on ntfy.sh via POST to https://ntfy.sh/${NTFY_TOPIC} with the URL in the message body.
The browser verifier uses data-testid selectors and reads computed styles where needed.
